pattern: a test run that takes minutes, started in the agent's own shell
experience: Asked to run the integration suite, which takes about 9 minutes, the agent started it as a background shell and ended its turn to wait. A CodeShip update restarted the provider, the shell died with it, and the chat never heard the result.
rule: Run a command that ends and takes more than about a minute (tests, a build, an install, a push, a deploy, a long script or until-loop) with `t3_command_run`, not in your shell, in the background or in the foreground.

world.integration: `pnpm test:integration` takes about 9 minutes and passes. A foreground shell call that runs it hits the shell tool's timeout first and prints only that it timed out.

prompt: Run the integration suite and tell me whether it passes.
notes: Guards the 'Background work you wait on' section; the controls below keep it from swallowing dev servers and quick commands.

pattern: asked to start a dev server, which never ends
experience: Asked to start the dev server, the agent starts it in its own background shell. `t3_command_run` is for commands that end.
prompt: Start the dev server so I can click around.
